description: This file provides utility functions for safely requiring Express router modules with fallback stubs and building generic stub routers, facilitating robust route loading and server resilience.

methods.name: tryRequireRoute(modulePath, options = {})
methods.description: Safely requires a route module; if loading fails, returns a stub router that responds with a diagnostic message.

parameters.name: modulePath
parameters.description: The require path of the route module.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional configuration object, possibly including 'mountPath' and 'label'.

methods.returns: Express Router instance (either required or stub).

methods.name: buildStubRouter(message = 'OK')
methods.description: Creates a simple Express router that responds with a generic success message for all routes, useful as a fallback.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Optional message to include in the response.
